subject: The 2AM data that shocked our team
preview_text: We analyzed 10,000 users and found a pattern you need to see. It changes how you use Smart Notes.
body_paragraphs: Last week, we looked at 10,000 Smart Notes users to answer one question: what separates people who never miss a key point from those who still rewatch recordings? The answer made our team stop. Users who save their first summary within 72 hours of signing up are 5x more likely to still be using the app 60 days later. But here's the shocking part—most people wait. They tell themselves they'll use it for the next big meeting, then forget.

That hesitation costs you more than time. Our data shows each skipped meeting creates a 30% higher chance you'll lose an action item. And action items are the difference between a meeting that moves the needle and one that just eats your calendar. One user told us: 'I didn't realize how much I forgot until I had the transcript.' Another said: 'It's like having a second brain that never sleeps.' The pattern is clear: the sooner you start, the more you save.

You already have Smart Notes on your phone. The fastest way to break the cycle is to use the one-tap recording feature. Open the app right now, record your next call or lecture, and let the AI do the rest. In 5 minutes, you'll have a structured summary with key points and action items—ready to share with your team.

Your first summary is 60 seconds away. Tap the button below, record anything, and see what you've been missing. P.S. Founders who use this for investor calls tell us it cuts their follow-up time by 2 hours a week. That's a week back every month.
